goal: Operate cycle03 as a CT umbrella task: coordinate android_ide/backend_cli/frontend_ide execution, keep contract evidence synchronized, and publish final accept/blocked decision from schema-valid artifacts.

inputs.description: Current board, risks, and CT decision context.

constraints.notes: CT umbrella task must not replace worker task contracts. Route execution through orchestration/tasks/*.json and keep schema-first governance.

acceptance: Root task.json and cycle03 dispatch/worker tasks are trace/task aligned and schema-valid.
Cycle03 worker evidence is collected for android/backend/frontend with reproducible paths.
CT decision (accept or blocked) is based on strict gate status plus canonical handoff JSON.

risk.note: If umbrella routing and worker task contracts drift, CT can make incorrect acceptance decisions despite partial evidence.

next_actions: Dispatch android_ide/backend_cli/frontend_ide using cycle03 worker task files.
Collect refreshed result evidence and validate contracts before CT decision.
Publish final cycle03 canonical handoff and update integration_status.md.
